text: dsh-search-switcher 是面向 DSH Web 的搜索引擎切换插件，在对话输入栏模型选择器旁加入搜索菜单。它通过 dsh-free-search 的设置桥接读取当前 provider，并将用户选择写回 free-search.provider。菜单列出十种搜索引擎，标出当前项，并提供键盘方向键、Home、End、Enter、Space 和 Escape 操作。切换期间显示状态，桥接或设置不可用时展示错误与兼容提示。适合希望在 DSH Web 中快速更换网页搜索提供方的用户；需要安装兼容版本的 dsh-free-search。

dsh-search-switcher adds a menu beside the DSH Web model picker to switch search providers. It reads and updates free-search.provider through dsh-free-search, lists ten engines, marks the current choice, supports keyboard navigation, and displays bridge errors.
想在 DSH 对话输入框旁边快速换一个网页搜索引擎。
DSH 能不能不进设置页就切换当前搜索提供方？
让 DSH Web 的输入栏提供搜索引擎下拉菜单。
我想在 DuckDuckGo、Bing 或其他搜索服务之间一键切换。
校园网连不上默认搜索服务时，怎样换到另一个搜索提供方？
希望用键盘打开搜索菜单并移动到想选的引擎。
How can I change the web search provider from the composer without opening settings?
I need a keyboard-friendly menu to choose a search engine in DSH Web.
dsh-search-switcher 的功能「切换搜索引擎」：在输入栏模型选择器旁打开引擎菜单。点击选项后写入 free-search.provider，并更新当前选择；触发方式为菜单按钮和引擎选项。
dsh-search-switcher 的功能「读取当前提供方」：菜单初始化时通过设置桥接查询 free-search 命名空间，并在触发器上显示当前引擎；命名空间未提供时展示诊断提示。
dsh-search-switcher 的功能「键盘操作菜单」：使用方向键在搜索引擎间移动，Home 和 End 跳到首尾；Escape 关闭菜单并将焦点还给触发按钮。
dsh-search-switcher 的功能「兼容性提示」：设置桥接无法访问或 free-search 命名空间未暴露时，在菜单中显示诊断文本，写回失败时显示桥接返回的错误信息。
Requires dsh-free-search >=0.4.7 for provider access; without it, switching is unavailable (package.json:41-43).

dsh-search-switcher README · dsh-search-switcher：[](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

A compact web-search-engine switcher for the DeepSeek Harness composer. It renders immediately to the **left of the model picker** and changes the preferred engine without opening Settings or typing a slash command.

中文：在 DeepSeek Harness 输入栏的模型切换器左侧提供搜索引擎热切换下拉菜单，无需打开设置或输入命令。

dsh-search-switcher README · Features：- Composer control next to the model picker via `conversation.input.right`.
- Scrollable engine list with the current engine marked.
- Reads and writes the `free-search.provider` setting through the loopback bridge.
- Supports the ten engines exposed by `dsh-free-search`:
  - DuckDuckGo HTML
  - DuckDuckGo Lite
  - Bing
  - AnySearch AI
  - SearXNG
  - Exa
  - Tavily
  - Keenable
  - Perplexity
  - DeepSeek Official
- Uses the Harness theme variables.
- Full keyboard support: Arrow keys open the menu from the trigger and move between engines, Home/End jump to the first/last entry, Enter/Space activate, Escape dismisses and returns focus to the trigger.

dsh-search-switcher README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness Web profile with Node.js 20 or newer.
- [`dsh-free-search`](https://github.com/DDDMUC/dsh-free-search) `>=0.4.7`, which owns the settings bridge and the search provider.

The switcher only changes the preferred provider. It does not bypass provider authentication, API-key requirements, or network restrictions.

dsh-search-switcher README · Compatibility with `dsh-free-search` 0.4.22：`dsh-free-search` 0.4.22 registers its settings namespace through the `SettingsProvider.installSection()` method, which only exists in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings >= 0.1.2-alpha.2`. On older harness runtimes (DSH Desktop 0.7.1 bundles `0.1.2-alpha.1`; any `dsh` before alpha.2) that registration throws and is contained by Cordis, so the `free-search` namespace is never exposed: the settings bridge answers `/describe` with an empty `namespaces` list and `/mutate` with `settings-not-exposed`. The switcher then cannot read or write the provider — since v0.3.0 the menu shows that exact diagnosis instead of a generic "switch failed".

dsh-search-switcher README · Compatibility with `dsh-free-search` 0.4.22：| `dsh-free-search` | Harness `dsh-settings <= 0.1.2-alpha.1` | Harness `dsh-settings >= 0.1.2-alpha.2` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `<= 0.4.21` | ✅ works | ❌ fails to load (`installSettingsSection` removed) |
| `0.4.22` | ❌ settings-not-exposed | ✅ works |

Fix options:

dsh-search-switcher README · Compatibility with `dsh-free-search` 0.4.22：1. **Upgrade DSH Desktop / the harness runtime** to a build bundling `@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings >= 0.1.2-alpha.2` (preferred — `dsh-free-search` 0.4.22 works there as-is).
2. On the old runtime, **patch the installed `dsh-free-search` 0.4.22** locally: replace its `sctx.settings.installSection(...)` block with the exported `installSettingsSection(ctx, ...)` helper (identical semantics, present in the old runtime). The exact two-line diff is in the bug report on [DDDMUC/dsh-free-search](https://github.com/DDDMUC/dsh-free-search/issues) — please report it there so upstream ships a version compatible with both runtimes.
3. Or pin `dsh-free-search` at `0.4.21` or older while staying on the old runtime.

dsh-search-switcher README · Blocked-network use case：Overseas university and campus networks often block `api.deepseek.com`, which makes the DeepSeek Official provider unavailable while the rest of the harness keeps working. This switcher exists so you can fall back to Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, or another reachable provider in one click — no Settings page, no provider editing by hand.

dsh-search-switcher README · Install：Using the Harness plugin CLI:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Hudson-Junior-Wang/dsh-search-switcher.git
```

If your CLI uses the profile as the current default, this is equivalent:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/Hudson-Junior-Wang/dsh-search-switcher.git
```

Install `dsh-free-search` as well if it is not already present:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/DDDMUC/dsh-free-search.git
```
dsh-search-switcher README · Install：Then restart the Harness host or reload the Web UI. The new control appears immediately left of the model selector in an active conversation.

dsh-search-switcher README · Manual profile installation：Add the package to the profile dependencies and add `dsh-search-switcher` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The package's `cordis.patch.yml` loads its entry automatically.

If the profile already contains a manually inserted `dsh-search-switcher` entry, remove that manual patch before using `dsh plugin add`; otherwise the same loader entry can be registered twice.

dsh-search-switcher README · Development：```bash
npm test          # bundle smoke test (manifest, patch, syntax)
npm run check     # node --check on both lib files
```

The client bundle is intentionally a self-contained ModuleLoader bundle so it can be served by the Harness client-module system without a separate build step.
